title: Jesus... Will There Be Enough Money This Month?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus, will there be enough money this month?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Rent is due Friday and I have counted it four times.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You have counted the money four times. How many times have you counted Me?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: That is not fair. The numbers are real.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: They are. So am I. I am not asking you to pretend the gap is not there.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: To let Me be in the room while you look at it. You keep doing the math alone at midnight.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Because if I say it out loud it becomes true.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: It is already true. Saying it out loud just means you stop carrying it by yourself.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: And if Friday comes and it is still short?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then I am still here on Saturday. I never promised you a cushion. I promised you Me.

bible.text: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, because God has said, “Never will I leave you; never will I forsake you.” So we say with confidence, “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?”
